text.p: Accor SA's Hotel Sofitel North America Corp said it completed the sale/leaseback transaction for four of its U.S. hotels.
The terms of the transaction include a sale price of $109.5 million and an initial lease period of 22 years.
The sale/leaseback is part of Accor's financial plan to reduce long-term debt to pursue joint venture acquisitions, development leases and management contracts, Accor said.
Similar transactions involving several of Sofitel's European properties were completed earlier this year, the company said.
The four hotels are located in Miami, Houston, Minneapolis and San Francisco Bay. All four hotels will continue to be operated by Hotel Sofitel North America, the company said.
The name of the buyer was not immediately available.
